baseline.variant_facts:
The merchandise under consideration is a YV3 paddle card to silver cable assembly (part number 2358571-3). A cable assembly used to connect and transmit data between a motherboard and network card within a network server. It comprises high-speed data cables, ribbon cables, and low-speed power cables bound together and terminated with specialized terminal connectors and connection printed circuit boards (PCBs). The YV3 paddle card to silver cable assembly (part number 2358571-3) is assembled in China using components sourced from China and Malaysia.

The Copper wire, Connection Printed Circuit Board (PCB) and Molded pieces for end connectors are produced in China. The High-speed data cable (insulated wire with mylar tape shield, two copper drain wires, and outer tape) and Low-speed power cables (three insulated copper wires) are sourced from Malaysia. 

Final assembly in China: Cut individual cables to length and cut ends; Solder cable ends onto connection Printed Circuit Board (PCB); Assemble molded pieces for connectors on each end; Tape cables together and package finished cable assemblies for export.

key_factors: High-speed data cables and low-speed power cables
prediction.decisive_step: Manufacturing of the insulated and shielded data and power cables in Malaysia
prediction.reasoning: In cable assembly rulings, CBP consistently holds that cutting bulk cable to length, stripping ends, and terminating them with connectors and paddle card PCBs via soldering and molding do not constitute a substantial transformation. The essential character of a data/power cable assembly is imparted by the insulated and shielded cables themselves, which provide the core conductive and data-transmission functionality. Because the high-speed data cables and low-speed power cables are manufactured in Malaysia, the country of origin is Malaysia.
